description: This file defines an asynchronous implementation of a grain class for the Orleans distributed framework, providing async methods for setting and getting values with delays, extending base grain functionality.

classes.name: AsyncSimpleGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing asynchronous methods for setting and retrieving two integer arguments and performing operations on them, extending the base SimpleGrain and implementing ISimpleGrainWithAsyncMethods.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and retrieves the product of two numbers.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and retrieves the product of two numbers provided as parameters.

methods.name: SetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and sets the value of A.

methods.name: SetB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and sets the value of B.

methods.name: IncrementA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and increments the value of A.

methods.name: GetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and retrieves the value of A.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Initializes a TaskCompletionSource and returns its task, for external completion.

methods.name: SetX
methods.description: Completes the TaskCompletionSource with a provided value.
